summary: Backend suite covering admin product create+persist+photo, edit+restore Margherita 40cm, supplements create/edit/delete + allowed_extra_ids propagation, customer database (list/search/filter/profile), marketing consent at checkout (both orders placed, NOT accepted) and at account registration, manager toggle, CSV export – 29 passed / 5 skipped. UI smoke on /staff/customers confirmed the flow (18 rows, TEST_ search → 3, filter yes → 2, TEST_Consent profile with orders history and Marketing:Oui badge). Found and fixed one HIGH backend bug: customers.build_profiles projected out password_hash so every account holder incorrectly rendered as kind='staff' (stats.accounts always 0). Fix applied in /app/backend/customers.py – ★ COMPTE badge now works end-to-end.

rca_of_issue: Root cause of the 'account holder shown as staff / ★ COMPTE badge missing / stats.accounts=0' symptom: customers.build_profiles queried users with `find({}, {'password_hash': 0})` then decided `kind = 'account' if u.get('password_hash') else 'staff'`. Because the projection stripped the field, the check was always false. Fix: switch to explicit include projection that keeps password_hash (used only for the `kind` decision inside build_profiles; the field is never placed into the returned profile dict). Verified GET /api/customers?q=TEST_Account now returns kind='account' and stats.accounts >= 1, and the UI shows the ★ COMPTE badge on the row.
